meta.name: escalation-management
meta.description: Handles customer situations that have exceeded normal support — severity assessment, incident communication, executive escalation, and recovering a relationship after a failure. Use this when a customer issue is escalating or has gone to leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, when a major account is at risk, when a relationship needs repairing after a failure, or to design the escalation path itself.

copy.tagline: 让客户升级得到专业处置与关系修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要处理客户升级或修复重要客户关系
copy.tagline_en: Resolve serious customer issues and mend relationships
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage escalated customer issues and need to rebuild trust

howto.what: Claude 会按升级管理流程处理客户问题:从客户角度判断严重性,确定一名不消失的专属负责人,按固定节奏主动通报,先承认影响后解释缘由,不承诺未经确认的修复日期;恢复时优先展示修复而非空道歉,并事后做简短复盘。
howto.when: 当客户问题升级到需要领导层介入、发生影响客户的故障,或大客户有流失风险等场景时触发。

say.text: 客户核心系统故障,要求上报领导。请评估严重性并定沟通节奏。
say.note: Claude 会给出负责人建议和定时更新安排。

say.text: 凌晨的事故让客户很愤怒,帮我做个恢复方案。
say.note: 恢复方案会包含具体失误的承认和防再犯措施。

say.text: 客户要见高管,请给我准备高管简报要点。
say.note: 它会整理背景、已有动作和不能承诺的边界。

howto.what_en: Claude handles escalations: judges impact from the customer's side, names a visible owner, updates on a set cadence, acknowledges before explaining, avoids unconfirmed fixes, and reviews afterward.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an issue escalates to leadership, during a customer-impacting outage, or when a major account is at risk (etc.).

say_en.text: A customer outage has reached leadership; assess severity and plan updates.
say_en.note: Claude suggests an owner and a communication cadence.

say_en.text: The customer is furious after this outage; draft a recovery plan.
say_en.note: Plan includes owning the failure and safeguards.

say_en.text: The customer wants an executive call; brief my leader first.
say_en.note: It will outline background, actions so far, and boundaries.
